items.purpose: M7 rifle (SIG MCX-SPEAR): base model only, a 5.56 mm SIG MCX reshaped into the M7 by scripts/process-gun-m7.mjs
items.format: GLB (no textures: 18 flat-colour materials, rigidly skinned to 10 bones)
items.notes: Attribution: 'Low-Poly Sig MCX' by TastyTony (https://sketchfab.com/TastyTony), CC BY 4.0. Downloaded in full on 2026-11-11; licence confirmed the same day against the live Sketchfab API (label 'CC Attribution', url creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0, downloadable). The author's description presents it as their own model, not a game rip. 12,824 tris. It is an MCX Virtus with a 16 in barrel, not a Spear: no CC0 or CC BY MCX-SPEAR could be fetched without a Sketchfab login. Real Spear models do exist on Sketchfab under CC BY 4.0 but are not in Objaverse (published after its 2022 snapshot): 'low-poly SIG MCX Spear' by DU1701 (36ac159795ae465e8a4d44068bbaf434, 25,668 faces), 'SIG XM7' by Merukitty (9fcfa9ea071b48368ae08984637904aa, 11,496 faces), 'MCX Spear' by DokuDome (4157046e04a74856ab67aafee5043522, 13,328 faces); one manual download with an account would allow a true model. The other MCX in Objaverse, 'Sig Sauer MCX Carbine' by BRFrags (b6bf63cde51b40c5a506ace956df13cf, CC BY 4.0), has a slab for a receiver and was rejected. The source's bones (body, bolt, charging handle, magazine, two cartridge groups, dust cover, magazine release, bolt release, selector) become part nodes; its red dot and vertical foregrip are separate unskinned meshes and are dropped. One source unit is 0.204 m: the top rail then has the real 10 mm pitch and the rifle is 0.90 m long. No textures, so no maker marks or logos anywhere; the shapes of the receiver follow the real MCX. The M7's coyote finish is set in code (src/weapons/models/lib/m7-materials.ts).

items.purpose: SCAR-H battle rifle, first-person and world model
items.notes: Attribution: 'FN SCAR-H' by Alex_Z (https://sketchfab.com/Alex_Z), CC BY 4.0. Downloaded in full on 2026-11-12; licence confirmed the same day against the live Sketchfab API (label 'CC Attribution'). 23.9k tris in one baked low-poly gun (three meshes) plus a sling swivel; digital camouflage receivers, black furniture, suppressor, vertical foregrip and a holographic sight. Moving parts are not separate nodes, so scripts/process-gun-scarh.mjs cuts the magazine, trigger and left-side charging handle out by connected piece, drops the sight and foregrip, and converts the textures to metal/roughness. The colour texture carries a two-line maker's roll mark and a serial line, a few pixels tall; the script blurs both. One source unit is 0.023 m: the top rail is then 21.2 mm wide and the rifle 0.99 m long with the suppressor. Rejected alternatives: 'Low-Poly FN SCAR H' by Matrixxy (0eb62c0b4d584324a8a2242b7127d709, CC BY 4.0, 8.4k tris) is not in Objaverse; 'Low-Poly FN SCAR-H PR' by notcplkerry (336291d429fd40958d1e460d9f04cbc1) is the sniper variant.

gaps: CC0 realistic guns exist for only three of the seven slots: bolt-action sniper (Poly Haven), M4A1 (OpenGameArt) and a pistol that is a P38 style, not an M1911 (Poly Haven). No CC0 realistic M1911, M1 Garand, MP5, Remington 870 or M249 was found. All seven are covered with CC-BY 4.0 models, each needing a credit line. If the project must be CC0-only, the fallback is procedural guns built in Three.js from extrusions, lathes and bevelled boxes with the texture sets listed (Metal046A, Metal027, Metal009, Plastic012B, Rubber004, walnut veneer, Leather026, Fabric061).

Sketchfab downloads need a login (the API returns 401), so every CC-BY Sketchfab model here is fetched from the Objaverse 1.0 mirror on Hugging Face. Those GLBs carry 1024px textures only. A 2k or 4k tier for these guns means a one-time manual download from the Sketchfab source page with an account; plan the quality tiers around 1k for the Objaverse models, or upscale. Poly Haven and the OGA M4A1 do have 2k.

No single CC0 or CC-BY realistic soldier with idle, walk, run, aim, shoot and death in one file. Best route: doctortex soldier meshes (CC-BY, mixamorig skeleton, no clips) plus Quaternius UAL1 clips (CC0) retargeted in Blender and baked to one GLB. Until that is done, the Quaternius SWAT GLB (CC0, stylized) has the full clip set and works as a stand-in.

No rifle-specific third-person clips (rifle idle, aim, fire, reload) with a plain GET. UAL1 Standard has pistol aim, shoot and reload only. Fallback: parent the rifle to hand_r, use Pistol_Aim as an upper-body layer and place the left hand on the handguard with two-bone IK.

First-person clips exist for pump shotgun, magazine rifle, pistol, bolt-action sniper and SMG. Nothing for the M1 Garand en-bloc clip reload or the M249 belt reload; do those with code-driven arm IK and gun part transforms (the bumstrum LMG has belt links and ammo box as separate nodes; the Sky_Hunter Garand needs its bolt split out).

three.js examples Soldier.glb, Xbot.glb and Michelle.glb are Mixamo exports (the example page credits mixamo.com; Soldier.glb uses mixamorig bones with Idle, Walk, Run). Adobe's Mixamo terms allow use inside a game but not redistribution of the raw files, and it is neither CC0 nor CC-BY, so they are excluded.

Quaternius files (UAL1, UAL2, Universal Base Characters) are CC0 but the official downloads run through itch.io, not a plain GET. The URLs given are commit-pinned mirrors in third-party GitHub repos that could be deleted; copy the files into the Ironvale repo on first download and check the sha256 values in the notes.
Microsoft Rocketbox military avatars are MIT, which is permissive but outside the stated CC0 or CC-BY rule. Listed for a decision; skip it if the rule is strict.
